post.originalText:
Damn... Fable 5.2 just re-created a GTA-style game in one prompt

It took 2h 14min to make a Miami crime game playable in the browser

Driving, police chases, missions, a garage, day into night
Even the sounds are generated in code

The secret is the last line of the prompt:
“After each system, play it yourself, screenshot it and fix what looks wrong”

Rockstar: thousands of devs and over a decade
Fable 5.2: one prompt and a time
